Dear Pulse Foundation Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communication & Events Intern position at Pulse Foundation. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in social media content creation, community management, and AI-assisted workflows, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your purpose-driven team.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has honed my skills in digital communication and content management. I have also developed and managed social media content for mirook.com, including Instagram and Facebook integration, and I am comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to streamline content creation and research.

I am particularly drawn to Pulse Foundation's innovative use of AI to enhance communication and events. I am eager to bring my proactive mindset, creative approach, and technical skills to support your programs and help amplify your mission.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available for an internship starting immediately. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
